correctness.rationale: With F=uP+(u+s)xQ and G=v(P+xQ)+s y(P'+xQ'), eliminating x produces s H_y where H_y=vPQ+(u+s)yP'Q-u yPQ'; its degree and leading/constant coefficients follow directly. Identity uG=vF+sC and degree-m resultant homogeneity give s^m dividing Res_y(F,G) over the polynomial coefficient ring and H_x quotient. Extreme x-coefficients are (u+s)^m Res(Q,yQ') and u^m Res(P,yP'), hence edge discriminant factors, whereas the y extremes are (v+ms)a_m b_m and va_0b_0. Genericity and the nonzero boundary factors rule out torus escape; bidegree intersection (1,m)^2=2m, irreducible critical incidence graph solved by u,v and a rank-four pair incidence for distinct y values give degree 2m generic simple separated x,y coordinate projections. Independently formed symbolic Sylvester resultants and verified coefficient/divisibility identities at m=2 and 3 using SymPy; those finite checks only corroborate the general algebra and incidence proof. Exact claims are generic char0, not exceptional parameter intersections.
